text.en: A man inherits a precious box and cannot rest because of it.

The narrator is thirty-seven when his uncle Philip, a rich engineer and collector of rubies and pearls whom he has never met, dies. He is left a precious box that he fears might explode if shaken. He talks of it so much that library attendants think him a madman or a dynamite fiend and tell the police, and he is shadowed as a suspicious character.
The story is a dilemma, a difficult choice, and it shows how fear and worry can take over a mind. It builds suspense with the narrator's anxious thoughts.
Learn the words inventor, bachelor, mania, gems and dilemma. Note the first-person narration and the suspense. (The final outcome is revealed in the story; read it in your book.)
